'''Warrior's vests''' were an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were [[gray]] in color with [[red]] and [[Silver/Legends|silver]] shoulder plating.
